functions.lever: statement order in both block-fill branches: angles, reversed flag, control-point offsets, end.y, then startAngle -= 0x3243 and wrap last; hold counter written as if (hold <= 1) {...} else if (hold > 1) {...} to get the predicated strhgt/movgt tail
functions.notes: One raw offset read (Vector3i at GameResources+0x4438, a field the shared header leaves as padding). The redundant 'else if (holdFrames > 1)' is needed for the predicated block layout. The block-fill statement order was found by a scripted permutation search (about 70 wdiff compiles in /tmp/c2141-8) and then gated with wgate.
